title: Multi-browser installation hub
message: Version 3.5.0 adds a browser compatibility and installation page with browser icons, official store-search links, and honest support status for Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Brave, and Opera Mini.
features: Browser compatibility chart with browser icons
Official browser store-search and installation guidance links
Chromium manual-install guidance for Chrome, Edge, and Brave
Clear status notes for Firefox, Safari, and unsupported Opera Mini
No remote code loading; browser support status is documented transparently
